text: 近日，中国国家知识产权局副局长张志成在京会见来访的中国美国商会会长何迈可和会员企业代表。张志成表示，近年来，中国依法严格保护国内外企业知识产权，做到一视同仁、同等保护，努力为各国企业和创新主体营造公平竞争的发展环境。中国国家知识产权局愿意倾听业界声音，了解外资企业在知识产权方面的需求，有针对性地做好相关工作。何迈可表示，近年来，中国知识产权保护取得长足进展，为外资企业发展提供了良好环境。中国美国商会希望与中国国家知识产权局继续保持沟通并将持续鼓励会员企业坚定信心，投资中国。
text_en: Recently, Zhang Zhicheng, Deputy Commissioner of the China National Intellectual Property Administration, met in Beijing with Michael Hart, President of the American Chamber of Commerce in China, and representatives of member companies. Zhang Zhicheng stated that in recent years, China has strictly protected the intellectual property of domestic and foreign enterprises in accordance with the law, treating all equally and providing equal protection, striving to create a fair competitive development environment for enterprises and innovators of all countries. The CNIPA is willing to listen to industry voices, understand the IP needs of foreign-funded enterprises, and do relevant work in a targeted manner. Hart said that in recent years, China's IP protection has made significant progress, providing a good environment for the development of foreign-funded enterprises. AmCham China hopes to maintain communication with the CNIPA and will continue to encourage member companies to strengthen confidence and invest in China.
